name: independent-repair-submit
purpose: Evidence repair: re-establishes a claim an earlier record recorded unreliably. Every step asserts and throws if its outcome is not observed.

steps.action: A refused Portal submission creates no Request at all
steps.actual: Submitting "Ind refusal probe IND81T2F 1788849183213" with the required Field empty kept the reader on /portal/new/ind_advisory_intake_ind81t2f, marked ["request-field-ind_coverage_region_ind81t2f"] aria-invalid and reported ["Ind coverage region IND81T2F is required.","Fill Ind coverage region IND81T2F first — the form requires it."]. The Request list held 11 rows before and 11 after, and no Request carries that unique summary, so nothing was created. Supplying "Nordics" on the same form then submitted R-35, whose stored summary is exactly that string.
